mechanism: Atenolol (beta-blocker) may antagonize the sympathomimetic effects of levodopa and increase hypotensive risk, while levodopa may reduce atenolol's antihypertensive efficacy through competing sympathomimetic activity.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate regularly; consider alternative beta-blocker with less beta1-selectivity or dose adjustment of either agent; avoid abrupt atenolol discontinuation.
